schemaDoc.purpose: Single source of truth for what is verified, observed or merely inferred across the SportsDesk/Fantasy402 docs release. P2 (spec generator) and P3 (markdown generator) must consume this instead of re-asserting contracts.

operationFields.path: Exact path string as published in docs/openapi.json.
operationFields.method: Lowercase HTTP method as in the spec.
operationFields.operationId: Spec operationId, or null where the spec omits it.
operationFields.tier: A | B | C | E for operations. D is reserved for surfaces[] rows (real surfaces absent from the spec), so counts.D is 0 by construction.
operationFields.capturedResponse: true only when a real captured response body exists in the repo or GS extract. False for every row in this release.
operationFields.evidence[]: Array of {source, kind, note}. source conventions in sourcePrefixes; source 'none' means no artifact exists.
operationFields.requiredCapture: The exact capture (or implementation) that would upgrade the row.
operationFields.contradicted: true when a spec assertion is refuted by a concrete artifact; contradictedReason carries the quotes.
operationFields.candidate_url: true when the path+method is a candidate inferred from UI/DOM metadata rather than observed on the wire.
operationFields.ui_observed: true when a UI/DOM artifact exists for the operation.

surfaceFields.id: Stable id; every id appears verbatim in docs/EVIDENCE.md.
surfaceFields.name: Human label.
surfaceFields.tier: D = real surface recorded in surfaces[]; its routes may be published as operations or not, and missingFromSpec says which. E = documented operation with no implementation.
surfaceFields.missingFromSpec: true when docs/openapi.json does not publish every path this surface lists — including a surface whose members are field names or CLI commands rather than routes, which the spec cannot model at all. False therefore means fully published. The boolean was previously read both ways; four rows disagreed until scripts/check_ledger_consistency.ts derived it.

schemaDoc.counts: Operation counts by tier. A+B+C+D+E = total = 65. Surface counts are in surfaceCounts and are not mixed into counts. scripts/check_ledger_consistency.ts recomputes every number here — counts, surfaceCounts, countsByTag and the total below — from the rows, and `bun run verify:docs` runs it first. It also resolves every evidence citation: a capture: source must name a file in docs/evidence/captures (capture:<date>/<file>, the same form docs/openapi.json uses), and a file:line source must resolve in the repo with the line inside the file.
schemaDoc.countsByTag: Operation tier counts per spec tag (convenience for P2/P3).
schemaDoc.citationAnchors: Cited `file:line` or `file:start-end` (as written in the docs, prefix stripped) → a literal that must appear on one of the cited lines. scripts/check_spec_citations.ts (run by `bun run verify:docs`) fails on a citation with no entry, an entry no doc cites, and an anchor that has left its range, and reports where the anchor moved. Write the anchor from the range's first line where that line is distinctive, so a single hit also gives the corrected range. zip: citations name the external GS extract and are reported as unchecked.
